assertions: Lilly will deal with the seller and complete the purchase of Master B.'s houses, including the house he lives in on the Strand and the other houses offered with it
The agreement with the seller will be perfected rather than broken off: the seller is well disposed to the dealing and the bargain will be concluded
He will procure the money in time to pay for the purchase, despite his own money not being callable for six months at the time of asking

The money difficulty is one of delay and recalling/returning funds, not of outright failure: the retrograde lord of his 2nd house shows funds coming back to hand in time rather than staying locked away

The negotiation will involve friction and delay (the Moon's square translation and the retrograde, cadent significators) but this difficulty is softened and will not prevent completion, the square operating out of signs of long ascension
method: Lilly classical horary astrology (whole-house, classical significators, reception, application and translation of light)
reasoning: Seller's significator the Sun is placed in the 7th and received by Venus in exaltation near the 7th cusp, and the lord of the 7th is also lord of the 11th (the querent's hopes), tying the seller to fulfilment of the hope. Venus applies by trine to Saturn, lord of the 4th (the houses), which perfects the bargain between seller-side and the property; Saturn lord of the 4th has no material debility besides retrogradation and cadency, so the houses themselves are sound and obtainable. The Moon translates light by square, indicating trouble in the dealing, but the square is out of signs of long ascension and so is mitigated. Mercury, lord of Lilly's 2nd (money), retrograde matches the stated fact that his money cannot be called in for six months, yet retrogradation signifies return/recall of money to hand; read with the perfecting Venus–Saturn trine and the 7th=11th link, the money is procured in time rather than the purchase failing for want of it.
summary: Yes — he will purchase Master B.'s houses and will procure the money in time to pay, after some difficulty and delay in the negotiation and in getting his money in.
